analysis:
All three changed files are documentation only: docs/provider/cli-reference.md (head lines 1756-1758), docs/provider/direct-mode.md (head lines 45-48) and docs/reference/configuration.md (head lines 559-561). No executable code, authentication or attestation path, or trust-boundary logic changed.

The diffs document three memory and TTFT tunables: DARKBLOOM_TTFT_IDLE_CACHE_SWEEP, DARKBLOOM_TTFT_SEGMENT_RETENTION and DARKBLOOM_TTFT_SEGMENT_HOST_ZEROS. cli-reference.md lists them as launchd-forwarded passthrough variables. Each variable disables only on the exact value `0`. cli-reference.md and configuration.md say they are forwarded to the launchd provider job. They are performance and memory controls that default to on and are not security-sensitive switches.

The docs also describe retained free KV segments, and direct-mode.md describes standalone load-headroom behavior. Retained segments are described as uncommitted, uncharged and free, and as dropped on memory pressure, before a load gate evicts a resident model, and after 30 s idle. They are not prefix-cache payloads, so they do not touch the T-041 SSD cache posture (HMAC names, 30-minute TTL, salt scoping, KEK purge, DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE kill switch). The docs make no change to those controls.

Retaining free KV segments could in principle leave residual data in unified memory (T-028 class). The documented "new segments wrap zero-fill-on-demand host pages" and the `0` fallback to device zero fill suggest zeroing is retained. The docs do not state whether reused retained segments are cleared of prior-request KV data before reinstall. That is an unverified contract in the implementation, which was not supplied. No code evidence shows a regression, so this is recorded for the next pass rather than as a finding. Reviewers should check in GlobalKVCacheBudget.swift, EngineV2Factory+SegmentedBackend.swift and KVPoolReclaimer.swift that reinstalled segments cannot expose prior-tenant KV contents to a later request.

There are no threat-model assertions to update from the docs alone.
